fieldValues.title: A short response to the news has to be posted to each channel by hand
fieldValues.statement: Besides longer essays I want to write short responses to the news, a few times a week, and post each one on the muDemocracy website blog, on Medium, on Substack and on LinkedIn, and possibly as a snapshot on Instagram. Each channel has its own form and length, so one response becomes several hand-made copies, and at that pace the posting takes over from the writing.
source_ref: Owner, 2026-10-16: the next type of essay responds to news
